why: The listed theorems are GroupoidStr.π_eq_π_iff, isSaturated_iff and orbitSetoid_eq (universe 0); the rest are definitions, which B characterizes. B (a)/(b): the project's GroupoidStr (total comp whose laws are asked only on composable pairs, units stated as φ ∘ 1_{sφ} = φ) is exactly the text's groupoid with m on the fibred product (comp restricted to 𝐗 ₛ×ₜ 𝐗; conversely m extended by a junk value); (c), (d) mor and Isomorphic are literally the text's; (e) |X| ≃ {|x|} with π x ↦ |x|, whose injectivity uses the hypothesis π x = π y ↔ x ∼ y. B_to_A derives π_eq_π_iff from B (d)+(e) and isSaturated_iff from that; orbitSetoid_eq (the bridge to Mathlib's isIsomorphicSetoid) is not about anything in B and is re-proved outright. Pure packaging; no mathematical difference.
overlap: B_to_A: 32 shared project theorems, all GroupoidStr axiom fields (src_comp, comp_assoc, comp_unit, …), Isomorphic.refl/symm/trans, comp_unit_of_eq/unit_comp_of_eq and the proof fields of instGroupoid/orbitSetoid/homMk (reached through the statement of orbitSetoid_eq); no substantive lemma.
